purpose: Reduce OMEGA integration waste by separating real unabsorbed donor code from already-absorbed or still-platform-dependent lanes.

findings.title: Aggressive bounded self-improvement cadence

evidence.donorExecutionShape: up to three bounded tick attempts with 120s waits

findings.recommendedAction: Do not copy donor workflow wholesale. OMEGA-10 should port cadence/backlog-drain intent into the newer main proposal-generation workflow, preserving exact-base proposal and verification semantics.

findings.title: GENESIS mechanism assimilation forge + continuation graphs
findings.recommendedAction: OMEGA-07/10 should transplant continuation and assimilation mechanisms onto current main, then exact-head test them against current GENESIS metabolism and authority gates.

findings.title: NIGHT-09 command-center hostile cache and freshness hardening

evidence.verifiedMatch: main and donor expose the same v1.0.1 client policy text including secret-value redaction, future-cache rejection, live freshness bounds, graph caps, and stale observed-state downgrade

findings.recommendedAction: Treat as superseded unless remaining public JS/test diff audit finds a unique unabsorbed change. Do not transplant policy module again.

findings.title: Command Center 2.0

evidence.relationship: #416 hardens #412 and the critical hardened policy is already present on main

findings.recommendedAction: OMEGA-12 should build on current main Command Center rather than rebase #412. Audit remaining UI/PWA files only for unique missing behavior.

mergeOrder.action: Claude/OMEGA-00 refreshes truth and current-main ancestry before any transplant.
Reconcile #432/#433 Personal Civilization donor first because OMEGA-01/02/04 depend on its private zero-effect substrate.
Reconcile #422 continuation/GENESIS and #420 Gamechanger into OMEGA-07/10 with current whole-brain APIs.
Re-express #421 cadence intent on top of the newer main proposal-generation self-maintainer; never overwrite main with the old workflow shape.
Close/supersede #416/#412 only after the remaining file-level diff audit confirms no unique UI/test behavior is missing.

integrationRisks: Blindly merging technically mergeable stale PRs can reintroduce old ancestry or overwrite newer #400/#423 semantics.
Generated canon/readiness/visual artifacts must be regenerated from the integrated current head, not copied from donor branches.
Workflow cadence changes must preserve the newer exact-source proposal compiler and verification/promotion path already present on main.
Donor source presence is not exact-head verification; each transplant requires focused and appropriate broader gates.

progress.deltaReason: Donor ambiguity and merge risk were materially reduced, but no new runtime capability has been verified on main, so percentages remain unchanged.

truthBoundary: This ledger is repository triage and integration guidance. It does not claim donor code is green, deployed, or current until reconciled and verified on an exact current head.
